verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents in-product AI in the Billing UI that answers questions and completes tasks [docs-16], which suggests data-grounded Q&A. Separately, Chargebee AI can draft catalog items from a pricing page or description [docs-14], but that is a configuration aid rather than insights from the user's own data. The evidence is a single thin mention, and nothing shows proactive AI-generated insights, recommendations or analytics over billing or revenue data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI insights or suggestions derived from customer billing data, examples of the kinds of insights produced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
